name: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited
summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited, incorporated in 2023 and based in New Delhi, produces metallurgical grade alumina and aluminium goods under the VEDANTAL brand, including ingots, billets, slabs, wire rods and foundry alloys. It also runs an independent power plant of 3015 megawatts. Its products serve aerospace, defence, transportation, packaging and power distribution.
